title: RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0 Is Having Problems… 3 Hotfixes Already!
author: Marc Antony Gaming
description:
RuneScape: Dragonwilds 1.0 is here, but after 3 hotfix updates, players are still reporting problems. In this video, we look at the latest RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0 update, hotfixes, save issues, crashes, bugs and performance problems.

Has RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0 launched too early? We take a look at what Jagex has fixed so far, what players are saying about the 1.0 launch, and whether more Dragonwilds updates and hotfixes are needed.

Let me know what you think about RuneScape: Dragonwilds in the comments!

transcript.text: Runescape, Dragon Wilds has officially hit version 1, but just days after launch, players have already found some
pretty serious problems. So, what exactly are gamers complaining about, when are Jagex going to fix it,
and despite all the negativity, is Dragon Wilds actually doing well? Let's get into it. The biggest issue following
the 1 launch has been world saves. Some players reported their worlds becoming corrupted, while others discovered that
their worlds had completely disappeared from the world list. And as you can imagine, potentially losing dozens or
even hundreds of hours of progress in a survival game has caused some serious frustration. The good news is that Jagex
moved pretty quickly. On September 18th, they released hotfix 1.0.0.4, which included a fix designed to stop
world saves becoming corrupted when leaving a game session. However, there's another problem where worlds can become
missing or invisible, and that one is still being investigated. Jagex says they're working with the console
platform teams and hope to make those worlds reappear in a future patch. The hotfix also tackled crashes caused by
changing certain settings, and even a bizarre crash caused by casting a fishing rod at a player-built structure.
But bugs aren't the only complaint. Some long-time players think the new Scorned Wilderness content simply isn't big
enough for a 1 release. Players on Reddit have criticized the area for feeling too linear, reusing enemies, and
essentially becoming a run towards the cool boss fight rather than another huge area to explore. There are also
complaints on Steam about optimization, glitches, controller key binds, and the game still feeling unfinished in certain
areas. But here's the interesting part. Despite those complaints, the overall player reaction is actually still pretty
positive. At the time of writing, Dragon Wilds has an 82% positive rating from more than 23,000 English Steam reviews.
Recent reviews are slightly lower, sitting at around 75% positive. And commercially, this game is definitely
not a failure. Jagex confirmed Dragon Wild sold more than 1.5 million copies during early access alone. The 1.0
launch has also given the Steam player account a massive boost with more than 25,000 concurrent players recorded
following release. And remember, that's Steam alone. Dragon Wilds is now also on PlayStation 5, Xbox
Series consoles, and Nintendo Switch, too. While also being included with Xbox Game Pass and PlayStation Plus Extra and
Premium. So, what happens next? Jagex says Dragon Wilds will continue receiving monthly updates, and another
update called Luminance is planned for this winter, with Jagex specifically saying December. There's also another
optimization and LOD fix currently targeted for the 1.0.1 update in October. So, Dragon Wilds 1 has
definitely had a messy start. There are bugs, save problems, and players questioning whether the game really
deserved to leave early access yet. But, with over 1.5 million early access sales, mostly positive Steam reviews,
and Jagex already pushing out emergency fixes, Dragon Wilds [music] clearly isn't finished growing. The real
question is whether Jagex can fix these problems quickly enough to keep all those new console players around. What
do you think? Should Dragon Wilds have stayed in early access for another few months, or are you happy with the 1.0
release? Let me know down below. And if you enjoyed the video, make sure to hit that like button and subscribe to
the channel for more RuneScape Dragon Wilds news, updates, and gaming content. Thanks for watching, and I'll see you in
the next one.
